items.content_html: Callout — Private, peer-to-peer voice and messaging for desktop. No accounts, no servers, no stored data. Identities are Ed25519 keypairs that live only on your device; messages and calls go directly between peers over encrypted WebRTC. A lightweight WebSocket server handles connection signalling only — it sees nothing and stores nothing.
